I think that Artificial General Intelligence could be built in next 10-40 years. Now lets think what that AGI would need to be fully autonomous. It needs energy, raw materials and tools. All those three are areas where full automaticity can be achieved and humanity works toward it voluntarily. So basically it needs few nuclear, solar or windmill plants. It needs many autonomous mining companies and machines and lots of custom built robots for maintenance. And finally some autonomous factories with lots robots. Basically it should want to develop optimal components to build better machines/robots to to harvest more materials to increase its processing speed and memory capacity to become even smarter. Yes this AGI will need many things to work seamlessly, but being super intelligent it can figure out this logistics clockwork fairly quickly. And being very smart it probably figures out that it needs also protection against mankind. But I guess it doesn't want or need to kill humankind but just protect its self. As long as we don't threaten its existence we should be mostly OK. Some population control is probably needed though, but this can be achieved without any violence or opposition by letting people just live their hedonistic lifestyle until many die because of poor health. This AGI would be almost as god. Being 47y in 2021 I believe that this technological singularity will happen in my lifetime - if I manage to live to 80+
